newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran electricity exports earn Tehran $15 million.
newsitem.headline: Iran electricity exports earn Tehran $15 million.

text.p: Iran exports 350 million kilowatts hours a year of electricity which earns Tehran $15 million, Bahman Masoudi, deputy of the state power company in charge of planning, told the official news agency IRNA on Wednesday.
Iran's electricity exports run to Turkmenistan, Turkey and Azerbaijan's enclave of Nakhichevan, IRNA quoted Masoudi as saying.
Exports to Turkey started in August under an accord signed by Turkey's Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan in Iran.
